problem_statement: Industrial facilities struggle to identify avoidable electricity demand and carbon emissions.
product_description: Energy intelligence software that analyzes facility data and recommends operational efficiency actions.
market_notes: Electrification and reporting requirements expand demand for auditable energy analytics.
differentiation: Fast deployment on existing meters plus a proprietary library of equipment-level energy signatures.
founder_notes: CEO previously operated industrial plants; CTO led applied machine-learning infrastructure at a public software company.
risk_notes: Long enterprise sales cycles; integrations vary by facility; savings claims require customer validation.

problem_statement: Small lenders rely on spreadsheets and fragmented tools to monitor borrower performance.
product_description: Workflow and monitoring platform that consolidates borrower reporting and highlights covenant or liquidity risks.
market_notes: Private-credit growth and tighter monitoring expectations support category demand.
competitors: Loan servicing platforms; internal spreadsheets; credit data vendors
differentiation: Purpose-built monitoring workflows with configurable borrower portals and explainable alerts.
founder_notes: Founders combine commercial lending and enterprise workflow experience; senior technical hiring is incomplete.
risk_notes: Concentrated customer base; regulated buyers create long procurement cycles; limited proof of expansion revenue.

problem_statement: Specialty clinics lose staff time and patient revenue when referrals are incomplete or routed manually.
product_description: Referral intake and triage automation that extracts documents, checks eligibility, and routes patients to appropriate care teams.
market_notes: Administrative labor shortages and specialty-care demand create a sizable workflow opportunity.
competitors: EHR workflow modules; healthcare automation vendors; manual intake teams
differentiation: Specialty-specific routing models and a human-review workflow designed for clinical operations.
founder_notes: CEO managed multi-clinic operations; technical cofounder has healthcare integration experience.
risk_notes: Runway is limited; protected-health-information controls need deeper diligence; gross margin is below mature SaaS levels.

problem_statement: Independent online sellers lack affordable access to predictable regional delivery capacity.
product_description: Two-sided delivery marketplace matching commerce brands with vetted regional logistics operators.
market_notes: Ecommerce delivery remains large but pricing and carrier supply are cyclical.
competitors: National parcel carriers; shipping aggregators; regional courier brokers
differentiation: Dynamic regional capacity allocation and merchant-facing delivery-performance analytics.
founder_notes: Team has marketplace operations experience; no founder has previously scaled a logistics network nationally.
risk_notes: Low gross margin; moderate retention; incumbent pricing pressure; marketplace liquidity differs substantially by region.
